name: kinboard-native
description: iOS (and Android) app shell for Kinboard, built with Capacitor.

scripts.web: rm -rf www && cp -R ../web www && rm -f www/sw.js
scripts.setup:ios: npm run web && npx cap add ios && npm run assets && npx cap sync ios
scripts.ios: npm run web && npx cap sync ios && npx cap open ios
